# Paulo Albuquerque

> Senior engineer based in Dublin, originally from Brazil. Building AI workflows and automations for small businesses.

Paulo Albuquerque writes about AI workflows, automation, and reducing friction in everyday operations for small businesses. His blog at myneatflow.com documents experiments and learnings from building NeatFlow, an AR automation tool for small B2B service firms.

## Background

- Senior support engineer at a major SaaS company
- Located in Dublin, Ireland
- Brazilian, based in Ireland since 2015
- Background: enterprise SaaS support, APIs, integrations, data flows
- Building tools with: n8n, Claude API, Airtable, Astro, TypeScript

## Topics covered

The blog focuses on:
- AR (Accounts Receivable) automation for small B2B service firms
- Cash flow problems in small businesses
- AI agents for finance operations
- Build vs buy decisions for automation
- Practical AI workflow implementation
- Tool comparisons (QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, n8n, Make)
